question: The Eighth Five Year Plan of India got delayed due to ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**political uncertainty at the Centre.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eighth Five-Year Plan of India:-**

 
 
• **It got delayed due to political turmoil at the center as well as the global economic changes and fiscal imbalances of the country in the late 1980s.**
 
• It was originally scheduled to begin in 1990, but it was delayed by two years and finally launched in 1992.
 
• This was due to a number of factors, including:
 
 
• The assassination of Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi in 1991, which led to a period of political instability.
 
• The economic crisis of 1991, which forced the government to implement a series of austerity measures.
 
• The global economic recession of the early 1990s, which reduced demand for Indian exports.
